crystal_phase.Al13Co4: orthorhombic (Pearson symbol oP102, space group Pmn21, No. 31)

Characterization_methods: X-ray diffraction by single-crystal and powder specimens
Proof in the paper: The crystal structure of Al13Co4 has been determined by Grin et al. using X-ray diffraction by single-crystal and powder specimens. The structure is orthorhombic (Pearson symbol oP102, space group Pmn21, No. 31). The (1\xa00\xa00) surface has been investigated by Addou et al. using low-energy electron diffraction and scanning tunneling microscopy (STM).
